{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
sales = sales[~qa_mask]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
sales = sales[~refunded_mask]

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN
sales['customer_age'] = sales['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Check balance between channels and customer segment
print("Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(sales['channel'], sales['customer_segment']))

# Check the conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = sales.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conversion_by_channel)

# Check the average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = sales.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()
print("\nAverage revenue by channel:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Check the median revenue by channel (robust to outliers)
median_revenue_by_channel = sales.groupby('channel')['revenue'].median()
print("\nMedian revenue by channel:")
print(median_revenue_by_channel)"}
